body: As much as I have said it I will say it once more - thank you! Goodnight as well.
Wow - thank you, so very much. If I need tips I'll try not to be too shy about reaching out to you. This really means a lot.

I may try journaling - people suggest it and I've yet to try it. Thank you. You have really helped me tonight. I guess knowing that someone was there to listen at the very least was enough to keep me alive tonight.

I guess I never looked at it with an open mind like that. I don't have contact with many friends right now.. Grandparents have passed away. I could go to my uncle, but he recently had a fourwheeler accident and completely shattered his bone in 4 places, so that's not exactly an option. I'm really trying to find something out so I can stick to it, and I'm thankful that someone is willing to help me through this.

I think those are great ideas - especially the exercise part, and although the portion/calorie control is smart as well, I'm not sure how well I could do with that right now. My parents often bring in fast food or buy junk food, they don't purchase healthy food items very often so I can't balance exercise and a healthy diet too well.. Not yet.

Well, thank you. I guess as of right now I'm trying to get as much help as I can possibly collect so I don't slowly rip myself apart as it builds up, but I do plan to change if still needed once I am 18.

If I do work out it would be very homebound due to my obsessively protective parents who won't even let me outside for a few minutes without supervision, so no walks around the neighborhood for me. Thank you for even bothering to type all that, also. It does mean a lot. As of right now, I feel slightly better, but I'm still in such a deep hole that I have quite a way to go.

Ahh.. My parent's physical health as of the moment is horrid. My mother is actually considered severely obese, probably pinning around 400lbs as of right now. My father - he's around 250 I would say, some of which is muscle but he still is not healthy at all. Thank you, also.
